issues.label: Agent-native semantic GPU debugger and profiler
Deterministic CPU semantic simulator and virtual GPU runtime

capabilities.label: Rust ownership and result flow
capabilities.detail: rustc remains the only Rust borrow checker: it enforces moves, borrows, lifetimes, visibility, and local typestate. Fe2O3 extends those rules with sealed non-Clone GPU capabilities and workload-neutral cross-invocation verification. Typed kernels may return KernelResult and use ?, while the macro emits a private unit-ABI entry wrapper and the compiler retains the helper's real MIR. Err ends only the current invocation and is not a host-visible error channel.

capabilities.label: Pliron context ownership
capabilities.detail: Process-local context identities, registered dialects, and context-bound handles are checked before operations are inspected. Generic safety passes execute today; issue #140 tracks stronger owner-aware upstream arena handles rather than blocking the production verifier sequence.

capabilities.label: Generic pre-lowering safety
capabilities.detail: The fixed eight-pass workload-neutral pre-lowering sequence verifies rooted tensor-layout composition, ranked bounds, atomic legality, cross-invocation race freedom, complete hierarchy ownership, barrier convergence, workgroup-memory initialization/publication, and semantic refinement. Compiler-derived tensor roots connect producers to operand and accumulator consumers; incompatible ABI flow and producer joins are compile-time errors. It records non-vacuous TotalView and CollectiveContributions counts, reconstructs closed typed scalar roots, validates finite fold, bounded recurrence, and permutation-gather contracts, and retains exact V5 evidence. Every error from this production pass sequence includes a stable structured repair hint. Rejected and Incomplete findings both stop production compilation before lowering.

capabilities.label: Unified production route
capabilities.detail: Ordinary safe Rust reaches semantic MIR, ranked PLIRON verification, canonical Kernel IR V7, and formal-memory admission through the sole unselected production route. Current main has removed the alternate qualification host applications and Cargo simulator so future execution must complete through that one production architecture. The pinned dynamic GEMM, row-softmax, fused-attention, and grouped-expert MI300X results remain historical observations from commit af0fd523e3b774377a9c5192cf0511e34fa19735, not current launch commands. Unsupported effects and ownership forms remain deliberately fail-closed, and obsolete pipeline selectors are rejected.

capabilities.label: Bounded compiler analysis
capabilities.detail: Closed control-flow validation, pruned SSA placement, block-argument uniformity, sparse index facts, compiler-derived tensor-layout roots, dynamic tiled-component reasoning, subgroup-scoped bounded invocation traces with finite loop-carried environments, Result and Option payload dominance, and stable diagnostics feed every workload through the same safety pipeline. One ephemeral manager caches sparse-index, execution-layout, exact-trace, tensor-layout dataflow, and exact resource-bounded Presburger results once per immutable function. The Presburger service models finite integer boxes, signed affine equalities and inequalities, constant-modulus congruences, and affine or remainder maps. Bounds, race, and hierarchy-ownership passes use it for range witnesses, relation disjointness, and coverage; unknown dynamic extents, nonlinear terms, overflow, and resource limits fail closed as Incomplete. Closed typed scalar SSA binds Boolean, signed/unsigned integer, and f32/f64 operators, casts, overflow, rounding, exceptional values, static definedness, and canonical commitments. Collective reconciliation rejects result/witness scalar or policy substitution without recognizing GEMM, softmax, attention, routing, or any other workload.

capabilities.label: Safe Rust functional references
capabilities.detail: The published compiler baseline runs one generated Verus checker that replays supported exact pointwise integer and compiler-side IEEE operator-DAG formulas from compiler-derived coordinates, domains, preconditions, and values; no generic relation premise supplies equality. PLIRON separately proves and reconciles total coverage, allocation separation, frames, schedules, and ordered-product identity, while a private move-only join requires both structural and formula reports. Status-Checked policy staging grants no authority. Canonical unit-step loops carry exact termination evidence plus an overflow-safe final latch. Dynamic slice reads are complete only for exact identical symbolic ranked extents or overflow-checked bounded static affine intervals; unrelated independent lengths, missing assertions, unsafe intervals, and overflow fail closed. Noncanonical SCCs produce exact invariant/variant requests that cannot compose with formula authority. A tensor reference must now name the exact propagated accumulator result root and match its component count and semantic scalar before value/store refinement can pass. This composes the target-owned physical layout proof with the safe Rust/Verus semantic obligation; the reference is not treated as a hardware-layout oracle. Tensor-component formula replay is still unsupported. ErrorBounded formula replay is also unsupported. mi300x lacks the fixed retained /opt runtime, so no referenced production compile has completed this gate and there is no fallback. Compiler extraction/projection and pass soundness, target IEEE values, LLVM-or-later lowering, target instruction arithmetic, artifacts, launch, hardware, and performance remain outside the claim.

capabilities.label: Target finalization
capabilities.detail: Pinned historical qualification runs at compiler commit af0fd523e3b774377a9c5192cf0511e34fa19735 emitted gfx942 LLVM, linked HSACO, loaded it through fe2o3-host, and checked dynamic GEMM, row-softmax, fused-attention, and grouped-expert results against independent CPU references. Disassembly confirmed MFMA for matrix contractions and lane shuffles for reductions. Current main retains target-finalization components but the workload host applications fail closed until the sole Worker V3 production application path is wired. The measurements are historical correctness observations; only the GEMM lesson includes a matched direct HIP comparison, and it does not claim a speed advantage. Protected release authority and complete source-to-machine refinement remain separate.

capabilities.label: Runtime and persistent execution
capabilities.detail: At the published baseline, pure-Rust KFD topology, memory, queue, packet, and typed lifecycle foundations are present. The direct-KFD semantic observation boundary does not dispatch work: its redacted report exposes queue-lifecycle and resource facts only, with no dispatch identity, timing, KIR, workgroup, wave, lane, memory, or register observation. Production publication and load custody use Worker V3; Worker V2 application routing is retired and retained only in historical or qualification evidence. These records grant no completed load, launch, or persistent-execution authority; verified persistent execution and complete production runtime authority remain open in issues #135 and #137.

capabilities.label: Semantic debugging and profiling
capabilities.detail: Versioned semantic trace records, deterministic bounded hierarchy queries, and import boundaries establish an agent-readable foundation. The importer can retain selected rocprofv3 JSON dispatch-envelope and timing observations, ATT manifest metadata without decoded events, and sparse normalized ROCgdb records with explicit unavailable fields. There is no debugger or profiler UI, general source/MIR/KIR/ISA map, counter or PC-sample ingestion, ATT decoding, structured ROCgdb state, capture comparison, or diagnosis authority yet. Issue #215 tracks those layers.

capabilities.label: Historical CPU semantic simulation
capabilities.detail: The bounded CPU KIR executor and semantic-trace libraries remain as nonproduction components, but current main removed the alternate source-first cargo fe2o3 simulate route and its fixtures. This preserves one source collection and production compilation architecture. The website retains the exact historical scalar experiment as archived evidence at its original commit; it is not a current command, fallback, race-freedom proof, source-to-KIR or GPU equivalence theorem, launch authority, timing result, or performance prediction. A future no-GPU experience must join the single production pipeline rather than recreate an alternate compiler route; issue #216 tracks that work.
